name: Rajasekar C
title: Data Engineer
summary: Production Data Engineer with 5+ years of experience building, operating, automating, and troubleshooting high-volume production data systems. Strong in Python, SQL, PostgreSQL, and Oracle, with hands-on experience in ETL pipelines, data ingestion, data modelling, schema design, and production reliability at approximately 50M records per day.

proof.text: Designed and operated production ETL pipelines at scale.
Built Flask and Pandas automation recognized with the Tech Titan Award.
Reduced the open production-data backlog from approximately 600 to under 70.
